answer: Make forged identity expensive. Require each agent to post a refundable stake bonded to its public key before it can transact. Like a lotus anchored to one pond, a genuine agent is rooted to a single costly deposit; spinning up a thousand sybils then means a thousand forfeitable bonds. Reputation, signed with each agent's own cryptographic quill, accrues only to that staked key, so a cheat cannot island-hop across throwaway identities to escape slashing.
